meta.title: Improve `dev/update_changelog.py` performance by batch-fetching PRs with GraphQL API
meta.body_summary: Replace per-PR REST API calls in dev/update_changelog.py with batched GraphQL queries, reducing API calls from N to ceil(N/50) and claiming a 5-50x improvement for changelog generation.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot replaced sequential REST with batched GraphQL, providing a clear numeric claim; maintainer reviewed, cleaned up code, and merged after a successful test request.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 224 changed lines in a single developer tool file, this is a small edit by absolute volume and fits a focused, low-risk performance PR. The successful merge is consistent with its scope and the maintainer's quick approval.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot suggested replacing print statements with the logging module across multiple inline comments; these were not addressed but were non-blocking.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduces API calls from N individual REST requests to ceil(N/50) GraphQL calls, citing a 5-50x improvement.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Script-level API optimization using GitHub's GraphQL API; Copilot implemented chunking, error handling, and preserved output format. Merge required no benchmark, only a successful manual test request from the maintainer.

detection_detail.code_reading: harupy and copilot bot reviewed the implementation; bot provided nitpick suggestions on logging.
detection_detail.manual_test: harupy asked Copilot to test the script; Copilot ran tests, reporting all passed (though live API calls were blocked by firewall).

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler data; the numeric claim is based on arithmetic (API call count reduction) without measured runtime. Copilot's testing only verified code structure, not live API calls.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: harupy pushed cleanup commits (fb46627, cd4426f) that removed intermediate dictionaries and simplified the data flow before merge.

core_change_summary.description: In dev/update_changelog.py, added batch_fetch_prs_graphql() and _fetch_pr_chunk_graphql() to fetch PR titles, authors, and labels using GitHub's GraphQL API in chunks of up to 50. Updated main() to collect all PR numbers first, then batch-fetch once, replacing individual REST calls.
